text:
lee: quick brainstorm  how granular should the fallback "why" be on the rollout row? current idea is short reason + expand for details.

taylor: expand-on-click feels right. show top-2 signals and a tiny time-window sparkline, not full metric dump.

jamal: add small 'context blob' that contains compact audit keys (trace, cohort, commit) and a replay token so SREs can jump into playback. we call it an "audit blob" in the backend.

nina: operators asked for a 'quarantine' hold option on fallback: pause rollout traffic for N mins and route to staging. should be in the UI but gated by role.

lee: UX sketch: rollout row shows "fallback active" pill, small chevron expands a panel with: why-pills, audit-blob id (copy), quick actions: ack / sticky-override / quarantine.

taylor: how about sampling controls? want baseline sample, backfill-on-resolve, and circuit-breaker-aware ramp. e.g. baseline=0.5%, backfill=10% for Xm after resolve.

jamal: proto fields suggestion: fallback.audit_blob_id, fallback.backfill_rate, fallback.backfill_window_s, fallback.quarantine_minutes. keep names explicit.

nina: add a short required freeform when doing sticky-override: "reason (what fixed it)". reduce noise by making it required only for >10% traffic rollouts.

ops-bot: ALERT: rollout/canary-7 triggered fallback due to p95_latency_ms > 800 (5m window). audit_blob_id=ab_20260301_x9. backfill sampling ramped to 10%.

lee: ops-bot format is good. include compact SLO snapshot in blob so we can render a micro-dashboard instantly. small JSON compressed string works for the blob.

taylor: UI perms: quick actions visible if role in [operator, admin]. others see readonly pill + copy-blob button.

jamal: replay token idea: ephemeral token in audit_blob linking to a playback session. token expiry 7 days. include link in console with small lock icon.

nina: on mobile, avoid full panel; open modal with the same affordances. keyboard focus should land on ack button first.

lee: API config sketch (proto-friendly keys):

```
fallback_policy {
  mode: GENTLE  // OFF, GENTLE, STRICT
  audit_blob_sample_pct: 0.5
  backfill_on_resolve_pct: 10.0
  backfill_window_s: 1800
  quarantine_minutes: 15
  triggers: [
    { name: "p95_latency_ms", window_mins: 5, threshold_ms: 800 },
    { name: "5xx_rate", window_mins: 10, threshold_pct: 1.0 }
  ]
}
```

jamal: can we store a compact SLO summary: {slo:0.995, observed_p95:812} inside the blob so console shows green/yellow/red inline.

taylor: also add a small "why-playback" link that opens a pre-filtered playback with time-range auto-set to trigger window. needs audit_blob.replay_token.

lee: ops question: do we auto-escalate sampling when fallback persists? proposal: auto-escalate after T seconds and then backfill-on-resolve. default T=300s.

nina: yes but make this configurable per-rollout. some teams want manual only.

jamal: audit requirements: every action (auto-fallback, ack, sticky-override, quarantine) writes an audit row with actor, blob id, action, freeform_reason, and compact_trace. exportable CSV.

taylor: to reduce noise, tag auto-fallback events as severity=notice; operator acknowledgements are severity=action. filters in audit UI should default to showing actions first.

ops-bot: NOTE: audit export ready at /audit/export/ab_20260301_x9.csv

lee: next steps: jamal will add audit_blob_id + replay_token to proto, nina will draft modal copy and role rules, taylor will mock expanded panel. sync Friday 10am.

nina: adding one more: small tooltip on blob copy: "copy contains minimal troubleshooting context, not raw logs". keeps expectations clear.

lee: perfect. thanks all.
